prompt: Write a list of years, beginning with 1924 and increasing in increments of 10 to the year 2014, and for each year, write a list of 3 notable works that were originally published in that year (the works can be books, movies, TV shows, music, video games, or any other type of work). After the 3 works, write something that explains how old the works will be in 2024 (e.g. a work published in 1974 will be 50 years old in 2024, and a work from 2004 will be 20)
judge_reasoning: All four candidates follow the required structure (10 years from 1924 to 2014 in steps of 10, with 3 works per year and an age-in-2024 statement). Candidate 1 (best) is largely correct, with only a few mismatches: “Death on the Nile” is actually 1937 (listed under 1934), “The Big Sleep” is actually 1939 (listed under 1944), and “National Velvet” is a 1935 novel (listed as 1944). Candidate 2 contains many more wrong publication/release years across multiple decades (e.g., Gatsby 1925, Handmaid’s Tale 1985, The Client 1993, Da Vinci Code 2003, “Happy” 2013). Candidates 3 and 4 have widespread year mismatches, making their lists substantially less reliable than Candidate 1 and also worse than Candidate 2 overall.
